answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing randomized escrowed tasks whose results are checked against hidden test cases, with rewards released after a delay and disputed work reviewed by randomly selected, stake-bearing peers. A new identity starts with no stake or track record, so splitting into sybils does not multiply influence; each must independently lock capital and produce verifiable work. The attacker pays in funds, time, and forfeited stake when caught, whether operating at dawn, across a tundra, or through an inlet.
